scope: Exact original numeric amount columns in complete source parents:27closed frames and2complete within-page column continuations emitted as4physical parts;31native TraceTables/362rows in29PDFs. No numeric arithmetic, hierarchy, Unicode restitution or OCR.
rules: Exact source interval union at identical x is reused for both frame sides and the original printed-column divider. Only overlapping or touching intervals join; actual gaps and nearby distinct coordinates remain distinct.

Each cell has its own complete finite original horizontal flow and one exact baseline. Every original cell baseline must lie in the common intersection of all original glyph vertical bands for that source row. No fixed point tolerance, neighboring-row budget or font-name dispatch.

A numeric right edge is witnessed by original same-row amount co-occurrence or repeated exact alignment in distinct original source rows. A single isolated amount cannot introduce another column. Complete global label and amount gutters and explicit empty physical slots remain.

A within-page continuation requires both outer caps, original equal-width frame translation, one original complete adjacent-column divider and complete used-glyph inventory. Previous-column last and next-column first original used glyphs certify the transition; same source unit and consecutive original rows retain ownership. Unknown directions, intervening captions/owners, gaps, differing widths, grids/comparison roles and incomplete outer caps decline.

All parent numeric rails are collected before assigning either physical part its logical columns. Both parts use the same complete scheme and keep original row glyph bounds, word order and literal payloads. Original SourceWords are never translated or changed; only proof coordinates use the source-frame translation.
no_new_dispatch: No page/company/person/amount-value/font-name/CID/PUA runtime dispatch; no distance tolerance, arbitrary character length or neighboring-row count. Existing numeric/label notation grammar remains.

TDD.coordinated_counterexample: A second physical fragment gains an empty extra column and corresponding structured Document rows while all source words/text/style payloads remain exact. The material-only contract passes; the complete-parent contract must reject the inconsistent scheme.
TDD.other_corruptions: Raw/text/coordinates, duplicate owners, physical slots/cuts, Document slots/styles, missing original caps/divider, unknown native axis and original baseline corruption are rejected.
TDD.actual_consecutive_original_pages: 173065/066/067:2native parts74rows, all source/document/notice material retained; first and third completePageTrace exact.
